> | ~~38~~ | Foundations | Records→spacetime | **ROW CLOSED 2026-10-02 — every brick it named is built and its one open item, the `ST-3` decision, was taken by the author.** The ledger of it: the scoping note (2026-09-19), `ST-1` the causal accessibility cone ([`CV/RecordInfluence.lean`](../CsdLean4/CV/RecordInfluence.lean), 2026-10-01), `ST-2`, `ST-4`, the **event order** ([`CV/RecordCausalOrder.lean`](../CsdLean4/CV/RecordCausalOrder.lean), ★★★ `isPartialOrder_causalPrecedes` — the record events of a coupling graph are a **causal set**), and then `ST-3` in three parts once the author chose **candidate (5)**: its structure as **#99** ([`RecordLayer/MacroProjection.lean`](../CsdLean4/RecordLayer/MacroProjection.lean)), its instance as **#102** ([`RecordLayer/RecordMacrostate.lean`](../CsdLean4/RecordLayer/RecordMacrostate.lean), the record string, with no-signalling and the Born chain law both verified for it), and its stability as **#103** ([`RecordLayer/MacrostateStability.lean`](../CsdLean4/RecordLayer/MacrostateStability.lean), the macroscopic law exactly invariant under a record write and the pointwise string robust outside measure `k·N·δ`). **THE ROW'S FINDING IS CLOSED UNCHANGED, AND IT IS A NEGATIVE ONE: there is still no Lean shape for emergence proper.** What the row produced is (a) the causal shape of an **assumed** coupling graph — no metric, no signature, no continuum, no derivation of `E` — and (b) a macroscopic coordinate on `Σ` with the record statistics factoring through it. Neither is spacetime, and `M` is still a set of **labels** with no geometry. What follows the row is carried by its successors, each a numbered row and none hidden: **#39** (the `Σ`-local / spacetime-nonlocal restatement), **#98** (the two cones — reconciling this row's influence cone with `DispersionEarned`'s kinematic one, which is where causal structure would reach `M`), **#100** (effective stochasticity), **#104** (stability under motion of the base) and **#105** (where the overwhelming majority comes from). *As the row stood:* **Scoping note DONE 2026-09-19** ([`records-to-spacetime-scoping.md`](records-to-spacetime-scoping.md); M took S–M): what a record is in Lean, four candidate relations, the arena's limits, the constraining theorems, and four priced bricks `ST-1`–`ST-4`. **Finding: no Lean shape for emergence proper**; the missing piece is which coarse-graining projection defines the macroscopic coordinates (Paper D §5.2), a decision for the author, not a lemma. ~~The one Lean brick that is honest and new is `ST-1`, the influence preorder on records from the coupling-graph light cone (S–M, relative to an assumed graph);~~ **`ST-1` DONE 2026-10-01** ([`RecordInfluence.lean`](../CsdLean4/CV/RecordInfluence.lean), 254 lines, 11 pins; S–M took S–M): `Influences E S₁ S₂ n := S₂ ⊆ graphBall E S₁ n` with ★ `influences_refl`, ★ `influences_mono` and ★★ `influences_trans` — **the periods add**, which needed the two cone lemmas the CV chain had not stated (`graphBall_add`, `graphBall_subset_of_subset`). **TWO PRECISIONS ADDED 2026-10-02 after an external read of the live repository, both on wording this row and the module had loose:** (i) at a *fixed* budget the relation is **not** transitive — two reaches within `n` compose into one within `2n` — so it is a **graded reachability relation**, and the word *preorder* is now earned by the object it belongs to, `EventuallyInfluences` (`∃ n`), with ★ `isPreorder_eventuallyInfluences`; the module's title no longer says "preorder"; (ii) `Influences` is **permitted** influence, not **demonstrated** influence — every theorem built on it has the form *outside the cone ⇒ nothing happens*, and the converse (inside the cone, some influence occurs) is neither proved nor true in general, since a coupling along the path may vanish. That propagation is not fictional is the separate `spreadKick_not_supportedOn`; there is no equivalence between graph reachability and operational influenceability anywhere in the corpus, and the module now says so and calls the relation the **causal accessibility cone**; ★★ `commute_record_of_spacelike` — spacelike records are **jointly measurable**; ★★★ `arenaObs_heisenberg_kick_of_spacelike` and ★★★ `recordStroke_heisenberg_comm_kick_of_spacelike` — **a record outside the cone cannot be steered, with no error term at all** (the discrete-period companion of `record_lightcone`'s Lieb–Robinson bound: the evolved observable's support is inside the cone on the nose); and ★★★ `map_recordStroke₂_prod` — **the joint record law is the medium's product law**, for any translation-invariant channel law, so the fibre contributes neither correlation nor bias. **THE SCOPE HELD, AND THE ROW'S FINDING IS UNCHANGED:** this is the causal shape the *assumed* graph defines — no metric, no signature, no continuum, no derivation of `E` — and the factoring theorem is about the **medium**, not about the state: two spacelike records being statistically independent would also need the base readings to be independent, which needs a tensor factorisation of the field space over a mode partition that the corpus does not have. What is still missing for emergence proper is the coarse-graining projection (Paper D §5.2), a decision for the author. **TWO PIECES NAMED AND PRICED 2026-10-02, both recorded here rather than opened as rows.** **(i) THE EVENT ORDER — DONE 2026-10-02** ([`RecordCausalOrder.lean`](../CsdLean4/CV/RecordCausalOrder.lean), 7 pins; S–M took S): `RecordEvent` is a read region with the period at which its record is written, `CausalPrecedes E e₁ e₂ := e₁.time ≤ e₂.time ∧ Influences E e₁.region e₂.region (e₂.time − e₁.time)`, and ★★★ `isPartialOrder_causalPrecedes`: **the record events of a coupling graph carry a partial order — a causal set**, reflexive, transitive (★★ `causalPrecedes_trans`, the legs' periods adding exactly, `graphBall_add` with the ℕ arithmetic discharged) and **antisymmetric** (★★ `causalPrecedes_antisymm`: equal times force a zero budget, and at zero the cone is the region itself). The grading is gone because the duration is inside the relation. `EventSpacelike` is unorderedness, with ★★ `eventSpacelike_of_spacelike` — **geometry gives order** — and ★★★ `arenaObs_kick_of_eventSpacelike`: the same hypothesis that orders two events also protects the first's record from any unitary kick on the second's region, exactly. **THREE THINGS NOT CLAIMED, in the header:** the order is induced by an **assumed** `E` and is not derived from the records; it is *permitted* influence, inherited from `ST-1`; and `EventSpacelike` is **weaker** than `Spacelike` (it compares cones of different radii), which is why the dynamical theorem carries the geometric hypothesis and not the order one. *As recorded before it was built:* the cheapest brick left on this row and neutral with respect to the `ST-3` decision below. `ST-1` relates *regions* with a duration supplied separately; the object a causal structure wants is an **event**, a read region with an occurrence index, ordered by `e₁ ⪯ e₂ := e₁.t ≤ e₂.t ∧ e₂.R ⊆ graphBall E e₁.R (e₂.t − e₁.t)`. Then the duration is *inside* the relation, so this is a genuine preorder with no grading — a **causal set** on record events — and `graphBall_add` plus `graphBall_subset_of_subset` give transitivity with only the ℕ budget arithmetic to check. It would also carry the three unsteerability theorems to event pairs (spacelike = neither precedes the other). **The two caveats of `ST-1` survive unchanged**: it is *permitted* influence, and it is the shape of an **assumed** `E`. **(ii) THE `ST-3` DECISION'S OPTION SET, written down so it can be acted on.** The scoping note says `ST-3` waits on a decision but does not name the candidates; four are worth putting to the author, each with what it would buy: **(1) the record histogram** — `π'` sends a `Σ`-point to the multiset of records realised in a window (which contexts fired, how often); the record statistics then factor through it by construction, and `ST-1`'s relation descends to it; **(2) the influence quotient** — `π'` maps to the quotient of the coupling graph by the event order of (i), so the macroscopic coordinates **are** the causal order; tightest link to what is already proved; **(3) mode occupancy** — the occupancy vector of a fixed mode partition above a threshold, which connects to the CV rung; **(4) binned entanglement distance** — the finite metric structure `ST-2`'s `entDist` induces on a fixed family of sectors, with `ST-2`'s own caveat (a separation functional, not a proved metric) attached. **THE FACTORING REQUIREMENT CONSTRAINS THE FIVE, AND ROW 99 MAKES THAT PRECISE (2026-10-02).** ★ `factorsThrough_iff` says an event factors through `π'` exactly when `π'` cannot distinguish two microstates the event separates. A record basin is `globalBasin c i = {x \| x.2.1 ∈ circleCell (c.rate x.1) i}` — it depends on the **base** `x.1` through the rate field and on the **first fibre angle** `x.2.1`. So **`π'` may coarse-grain everything except the record outcomes of the family whose statistics it is supposed to carry**: it must determine, for each context in the family, which cell the fibre angle lies in. Reading the five against that: **(1)** keeps the outcomes but a histogram forgets their **order**, so the step-resolved basins of `csd_nstep_born` do *not* factor through it — only exchangeable statistics do; **(2)** as stated is not even a map out of `Σ` — the influence quotient is a coordinate on *regions and periods*, i.e. on contexts, and carries no information about which outcome occurred, so it can only be **extra structure on `M`**, not `π'` itself; **(3)** and **(4)** are honest functions of the microstate but likewise forget the outcomes (occupancy is a base reading, `entDist` is a property of the state), so neither can be the whole of `π'`; **(5)** is the only one that *defines itself* as a factoring coordinate, and row 99's `patternProjection` is already its skeleton — take the pattern of a finite family of coarse record events and the factoring plus both invariance theorems come for free, leaving **stability under the flow** as the physics. **RECOMMENDATION (2026-10-02, the author decides): (5), built as the pattern of an ORDER-RETAINING finite family of coarse record readings** — (3)'s occupancy is the natural content of those readings and (2)'s causal order is the natural extra structure on `M`, so the recommendation absorbs them rather than competing with them. **(5) THERMODYNAMIC MACROSTATES OF RECORDS** (added 2026-10-02): `π'` is the coarse-graining whose cells are *macroscopically stable equivalence classes of records* — the spacetime coordinates being thermodynamic macrostates rather than a chosen partition. This is the best-motivated candidate because it makes `π'` **selected** rather than **picked**: stability under the dynamics does the choosing. - **NG3** — spatial structure from the CV mode factorisation ([`eft-pillars-plan.md`](eft-pillars-plan.md) P3, reclassified 2026-08-19, ledgered at the Q22 close): a **ceiling by placement**, not a hard open problem. The factorisation and the regions defined over it are epistemic-side bookkeeping, and anchoring epistemic bookkeeping — however tightly — does not manufacture a spatial referent, so Route A's spatial index is a label, permanently. Not "done" (nothing was built) and not "open" (nothing is pending): the reclassification was the resolution. Cited when scoping (`FieldStructuredFlow.lean` scope block and the pillars page resolve to it); factorisation-uniqueness programs would select *which* factorisation, not earn *why space*, and so cannot discharge it.
